summary.text: Liish Kozlowski, listed by Ballotpedia as Alicia Kozlowski and also known as Liish, is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 8B who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Kozlowski lives in Duluth and faces Republican Shawn Savela in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Kozlowski lives in Duluth, Minnesota, and earned an M.B.A. from the College of St. Scholastica.
Kozlowski's career experience includes working as a community relations officer.
Kozlowski defeated Arik Forsman in the August 2022 Democratic primary for District 8B and Becky Hall and Jake Stewart in the November 2022 general election, taking office on January 3, 2023.
Kozlowski defeated Shawn Savela in the 2024 general election.
In the 2025-2026 session Kozlowski was assigned to the House Housing Finance and Policy (Co-Vice Chair), House Taxes, and Workforce and Business Development Finance and Policy committees.
